# Requirement
```text
We want to automate the management of a small municipal library. The library has a name and manages a collection of documents and a set of registered members. Members have a first name and a surname. Documents are uniquely identified by their title. Every document has a title. A volume is a kind of document and also has an author. A book is a kind of volume and also has a bookId that identifies the physical or catalogued copy. A dictionary is a kind of volume and also has a dictionaryId that identifies the dictionary entry in the library catalog. A comic is also a kind of volume and has a recipient name. A journal is a kind of document and has a publication date. Only books can be borrowed.
A registered member can borrow or return a book, and the system must always be able to list the titles currently borrowed by that member. A member can hold at most three borrowed books at the same time. When a borrowing succeeds, the system creates a borrow record containing the borrowing date, the borrowed book, and a return due date exactly seven days later. A borrowed book can be extended on request when the request is made before the current due date. A return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue. The system records dates in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Functional requirement:
1. Register a new member. The library registers a new member from a first name and a surname. The first name and surname must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only. The library rejects a registration when another member already has exactly the same full name. A successful registration creates the member with no borrowed books and returns true. Any rejected registration returns false.

2. Borrow a book and create a record in the system. A member borrows a document by title. The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

# Class Diagram
```plantuml
@startuml

title municipalLibrary Model

class Book {
    bookId : String
}
class BorrowRecord {
    borrowingDate : Date
    returnDue : Date
    book : Book
    extendDueDate(today : Date) : Date
    isOverdue(today : Date) : boolean
}
class Comic {
    recipientName : String
}
class Dictionary {
    dictionaryId : String
}
abstract class Document {
    title : String
}
class Journal {
    publicationDate : Date
}
class Library {
    name : String
    documents : List<Document>
    members : List<Member>
    addDocument(doc : Document) : void
    registerMember(firstName : String, surname : String) : boolean
}
class Member {
    firstName : String
    surname : String
    borrowRecords : List<BorrowRecord>
    library : Library
    borrowBook(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : boolean
    extendReturnDueDate(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : Date
    listBorrowedBookTitles() : List<String>
    returnBook(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : boolean
}
abstract class Volume {
    author : String
}

Book --|> Volume
BorrowRecord --> Book : book
Comic --|> Volume
Dictionary --|> Volume
Journal --|> Document
Library *-- "*" Document : documents
Library *-- "*" Member : members  'opposite: library
Member *-- "*" BorrowRecord : borrowRecords
Member --> Library : library  'opposite: members
Volume --|> Document
@enduml
```

# Requirement
```text
We want to automate the management of a small municipal library. The library has a name and manages a collection of documents and a set of registered members. Members have a first name and a surname. Documents are uniquely identified by their title. Every document has a title. A volume is a kind of document and also has an author. A book is a kind of volume and also has a bookId that identifies the physical or catalogued copy. A dictionary is a kind of volume and also has a dictionaryId that identifies the dictionary entry in the library catalog. A comic is also a kind of volume and has a recipient name. A journal is a kind of document and has a publication date. Only books can be borrowed.
A registered member can borrow or return a book, and the system must always be able to list the titles currently borrowed by that member. A member can hold at most three borrowed books at the same time. When a borrowing succeeds, the system creates a borrow record containing the borrowing date, the borrowed book, and a return due date exactly seven days later. A borrowed book can be extended on request when the request is made before the current due date. A return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue. The system records dates in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Functional requirement:
1. Register a new member. The library registers a new member from a first name and a surname. The first name and surname must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only. The library rejects a registration when another member already has exactly the same full name. A successful registration creates the member with no borrowed books and returns true. Any rejected registration returns false.

2. Borrow a book and create a record in the system. A member borrows a document by title. The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

# Operation Specifications
Member::borrowBook
Summary:
Borrow a book from the member's associated library using the book title.
Algorithm:
1. Verify that this member is associated with a library.
2. Search the library's documents for a document whose title exactly matches bookTitle.
3. Reject the request if:
   - no matching title exists,
   - the matching document is not a Book,
   - the book is already present in any member's active borrowRecords,
   - this member already holds 3 borrowed books.
4. If accepted:
   - create a new BorrowRecord
   - set borrowingDate = today
   - set returnDue = today + 7 days
   - set book = the matched Book
   - add the record to this member's borrowRecords
   - return true
5. Otherwise return false.
Related Features:
- firstName
- surname
- borrowRecords
- library
Related Classes: Member, Library, Document, Book, BorrowRecord
Input:
- bookTitle: String
  - Title of the book to borrow.
  - Must match a document title exactly.
- today: Date
  - The borrowing date, typically the current system date.
Output:
- boolean
  - true if the borrowing succeeds and a borrow record is created.
  - false if any acceptance condition fails.
Pre-condition:
- bookTitle is not null, empty, or whitespace-only.
- today is a valid date.
- this member has a valid library reference.
Post-condition:
- On success, this member gains one additional active borrow record for the specified book.
- The new record has borrowingDate = today and returnDue = today + 7 days.
- The book becomes borrowed by this member and cannot be borrowed by others while the record is active.
- On failure, no borrow record is added and no existing state changes.

Member::extendReturnDueDate
Summary:
Extend the due date of one of the member's own borrowed books by title.
Algorithm:
1. Find the active borrow record in borrowRecords whose book.title equals bookTitle.
2. If no such record exists, return the record's original due date is not possible; return the current date result as specified by the record logic, or if absent, no change cannot be applied.
3. If found, ask the borrow record to extend its due date using today.
4. Return the date produced by the borrow record.
Related Features:
- borrowRecords
- library
- firstName
- surname
Related Classes: Member, BorrowRecord, Book, Date
Input:
- bookTitle: String
  - The title of the borrowed book whose due date may be extended.
- today: Date
  - The date on which the extension request is made.
Output:
- Date
  - The new due date if the request is accepted by the borrow record.
  - Otherwise, the original due date of the matched record.
Pre-condition:
- bookTitle is not null, empty, or whitespace-only.
- today is a valid date.
- The member may or may not currently hold a matching borrowed book.
Post-condition:
- If a matching active borrow record exists and today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the due date, the due date is advanced by 7 days.
- Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged.
- No borrow record is created or removed.

Member::returnBook
Summary:
Return a borrowed book by title, rejecting overdue returns and returns for non-held titles.
Algorithm:
1. Find the active borrow record in borrowRecords whose book.title equals bookTitle.
2. If no matching record exists, return false.
3. Check whether the record is overdue on today using isOverdue(today).
4. If overdue, keep the record active and return false.
5. Otherwise remove the record from borrowRecords and return true.
Related Features:
- borrowRecords
- library
- firstName
- surname
Related Classes: Member, BorrowRecord, Book, Date
Input:
- bookTitle: String
  - Title of the borrowed book to be returned.
- today: Date
  - The date on which the return is attempted.
Output:
- boolean
  - true if the member currently holds the title and the book is not overdue.
  - false if the title is not held or the borrow is overdue.
Pre-condition:
- bookTitle is not null, empty, or whitespace-only.
- today is a valid date.
- this member has a borrowRecords collection initialized.
Post-condition:
- If the member did not hold the title, no state changes occur and false is returned.
- If the book is overdue, the borrow record remains active and false is returned.
- If the return succeeds, the matching borrow record is removed from borrowRecords and true is returned.

Member::listBorrowedBookTitles
Summary:
List the titles of all books currently borrowed by this member.
Algorithm:
1. Create an empty result list of strings.
2. For each active borrow record in borrowRecords:
   - read the associated book's title
   - append the title to the result list
3. Return the result list.
Related Features:
- borrowRecords
- library
- firstName
- surname
Related Classes: Member, BorrowRecord, Book, Document
Input:
- None
Output:
- List<String>
  - The titles of all currently borrowed books for this member.
  - The list is empty if the member has no active borrow records.
Pre-condition:
- this member exists.
- borrowRecords is initialized, possibly empty.
Post-condition:
- No state is modified.
- The returned list contains exactly the titles of books in this member's active borrowRecords, in the order they are stored.

The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

```text
3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

# Operation Specifications
Library::addDocument
Summary:
Add a document to the library's managed collection.
Algorithm:
1. Check whether doc is already contained in documents.
2. If not present, append doc to documents.
3. If already present, keep the collection unchanged.
4. No explicit return value.
Related Features:
- name
- documents
- members
Related Classes: Document, Library
Input:
- doc: Document
  - The document to be stored in the library.
  - May be any concrete subtype of Document, including Book, Volume-derived types, or Journal.
Output:
- void
Pre-condition:
- doc is not null.
Post-condition:
- The library's documents collection contains doc.
- If doc was not already present, it is added exactly once.
- The members collection is not modified.

Library::registerMember
Summary:
Register a new member with a first name and surname, ensuring uniqueness by full name.
Algorithm:
1. Validate firstName and surname are not null, empty, or whitespace-only.
2. Build the candidate full name as "firstName surname" using exact string values.
3. Search members for an existing member with exactly the same firstName and surname.
4. If validation fails or a duplicate exists, return false.
5. Otherwise create a new Member with:
   - firstName = firstName
   - surname = surname
   - borrowRecords = empty list
   - library = this library
6. Add the new member to members.
7. Return true.
Related Features:
- name
- documents
- members
Related Classes: Library, Member
Input:
- firstName: String
  - The member's given name.
- surname: String
  - The member's family name.
Output:
- boolean
  - true if a new member is successfully registered.
  - false if input is invalid or another member already has the same full name.
Pre-condition:
- The library instance exists.
- firstName and surname are provided as string values.
Post-condition:
- If successful, a new Member is added to members with no borrowed books and its library reference set to this library.
- If unsuccessful, the members collection remains unchanged.

# Operation Specifications
BorrowRecord::extendDueDate
Summary:
Extend the current return due date of this borrow record by exactly 7 days, based on the provided day.
Algorithm:
1. Read the current borrowingDate and returnDue of this borrow record.
2. If today is on or after borrowingDate and strictly before returnDue:
   - set returnDue := returnDue + 7 days
   - return the updated returnDue
3. Otherwise:
   - do not change returnDue
   - return the original returnDue
Related Features:
- borrowingDate
- returnDue
- book
Related Classes: Date, Book, BorrowRecord
Input:
- today: Date
  - The date when the extension request is made.
  - Must follow the system date type and be comparable with borrowingDate and returnDue.
Output:
- Date
  - The resulting due date after the operation.
  - If extension is accepted, this is 7 days later than the previous due date.
  - If extension is rejected, this is the unchanged original due date.
Pre-condition:
- today is a valid date value.
- borrowingDate and returnDue are valid date values.
- returnDue is not earlier than borrowingDate.
Post-condition:
- If today satisfies borrowingDate <= today < returnDue, returnDue is advanced by exactly 7 days.
- Otherwise, returnDue remains unchanged.
- The returned date equals the borrow record's current due date after the operation.

BorrowRecord::isOverdue
Summary:
Determine whether this borrow record is overdue on the given date.
Algorithm:
1. Compare today with returnDue.
2. Return true if today is strictly after returnDue.
3. Otherwise return false.
Related Features:
- borrowingDate
- returnDue
- book
Related Classes: Date, Book, BorrowRecord
Input:
- today: Date
  - The date used to check overdue status.
Output:
- boolean
  - true if the borrowed book is overdue on today; otherwise false.
Pre-condition:
- today is a valid date value.
- returnDue is a valid date value.
Post-condition:
- No state is modified.
- The returned value reflects whether today is after returnDue.

Algorithm:
1. Read the current borrowingDate and returnDue of this borrow record.
2. If today is on or after borrowingDate and strictly before returnDue:
   - set returnDue := returnDue + 7 days
   - return the updated returnDue
3. Otherwise:
   - do not change returnDue
   - return the original returnDue
Related Features:
- borrowingDate
- returnDue
- book
Related Classes: Date, Book, BorrowRecord
Input:
- today: Date
  - The date when the extension request is made.
  - Must follow the system date type and be comparable with borrowingDate and returnDue.
Output:
- Date
  - The resulting due date after the operation.
  - If extension is accepted, this is 7 days later than the previous due date.
  - If extension is rejected, this is the unchanged original due date.
Pre-condition:
- today is a valid date value.
- borrowingDate and returnDue are valid date values.
- returnDue is not earlier than borrowingDate.
Post-condition:
- If today satisfies borrowingDate <= today < returnDue, returnDue is advanced by exactly 7 days.
- Otherwise, returnDue remains unchanged.
- The returned date equals the borrow record's current due date after the operation.

BorrowRecord::isOverdue
Summary:
Determine whether this borrow record is overdue on the given date.
Algorithm:
1. Compare today with returnDue.
2. Return true if today is strictly after returnDue.
3. Otherwise return false.
Related Features:
- borrowingDate
- returnDue
- book
Related Classes: Date, Book, BorrowRecord
Input:
- today: Date
  - The date used to check overdue status.
Output:
- boolean
  - true if the borrowed book is overdue on today; otherwise false.
Pre-condition:
- today is a valid date value.
- returnDue is a valid date value.
Post-condition:
- No state is modified.
- The returned value reflects whether today is after returnDue.

    if (library == null)

      return false;
    }

    Document matchedDocument = null;
    for (Document document : library.getDocuments())
    {
      if (document != null && bookTitle.equals(document.getTitle()))
      {

        break;

# Task
You will be given a **Requirement** and a **Class Diagram** in PlantUML. Your task is to annotate every operation listed in **Operations** with a specification.

An operation specification must describe the following sections about the operation:
1. Summary: the summary of functionality;
2. Algorithm: algorithm or pseudo code;
3. Related Features: a list of structural or behavior features within this class that shall be accessed;
4. Related Classes: a list of classes and data types defined in **Class Diagram** that shall be accessed, in the format of `Related Classes: ClsA, CLsB, ...` or `Related Classes: None`;
5. Input: the input parameters, including the meaning, the format, and the value ranges if necessary;
6. Output: output value, including the meaning, the format, and the value ranges if necessary;
7. Pre-condition: the condition that the system and the input must satisfy before the operation is executed;
8. Post-condition: the condition that the system and the output must satisfy after the operation is executed.

Finish this task by following the guidelines below.
1. Take the principle of modularization into account.
2. For each operation, determine its functional boundary based on the given requirement. Ensure high cohesion and low coupling.
3. If there is any unspecified details, such as undefined constants, rates, and ratios, then you must infer them.
4. Make sure that all requirements can be covered.

# Requirement
```text
We want to automate the management of a small municipal library. The library has a name and manages a collection of documents and a set of registered members. Members have a first name and a surname. Documents are uniquely identified by their title. Every document has a title. A volume is a kind of document and also has an author. A book is a kind of volume and also has a bookId that identifies the physical or catalogued copy. A dictionary is a kind of volume and also has a dictionaryId that identifies the dictionary entry in the library catalog. A comic is also a kind of volume and has a recipient name. A journal is a kind of document and has a publication date. Only books can be borrowed.
A registered member can borrow or return a book, and the system must always be able to list the titles currently borrowed by that member. A member can hold at most three borrowed books at the same time. When a borrowing succeeds, the system creates a borrow record containing the borrowing date, the borrowed book, and a return due date exactly seven days later. A borrowed book can be extended on request when the request is made before the current due date. A return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue. The system records dates in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Functional requirement:
1. Register a new member. The library registers a new member from a first name and a surname. The first name and surname must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only. The library rejects a registration when another member already has exactly the same full name. A successful registration creates the member with no borrowed books and returns true. Any rejected registration returns false.

2. Borrow a book and create a record in the system. A member borrows a document by title. The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

# Class Diagram
```plantuml
@startuml

title municipalLibrary Model

class Book {
    bookId : String
}
class BorrowRecord {
    borrowingDate : Date
    returnDue : Date
    book : Book
    extendDueDate(today : Date) : Date
    isOverdue(today : Date) : boolean
}
class Comic {
    recipientName : String
}
class Dictionary {
    dictionaryId : String
}
abstract class Document {
    title : String
}
class Journal {
    publicationDate : Date
}
class Library {
    name : String
    documents : List<Document>
    members : List<Member>
    addDocument(doc : Document) : void
    registerMember(firstName : String, surname : String) : boolean
}
class Member {
    firstName : String
    surname : String
    borrowRecords : List<BorrowRecord>
    library : Library
    borrowBook(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : boolean
    extendReturnDueDate(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : Date
    listBorrowedBookTitles() : List<String>
    returnBook(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : boolean
}
abstract class Volume {
    author : String
}

Book --|> Volume
BorrowRecord --> Book : book
Comic --|> Volume
Dictionary --|> Volume
Journal --|> Document
Library *-- "*" Document : documents
Library *-- "*" Member : members  'opposite: library
Member *-- "*" BorrowRecord : borrowRecords
Member --> Library : library  'opposite: members
Volume --|> Document
@enduml
```

+ BorrowRecord::isOverdue
+ Library::addDocument
+ Library::registerMember
+ Member::borrowBook
+ Member::extendReturnDueDate
+ Member::listBorrowedBookTitles
+ Member::returnBook

# Requirement
```text
We want to automate the management of a small municipal library. The library has a name and manages a collection of documents and a set of registered members. Members have a first name and a surname. Documents are uniquely identified by their title. Every document has a title. A volume is a kind of document and also has an author. A book is a kind of volume and also has a bookId that identifies the physical or catalogued copy. A dictionary is a kind of volume and also has a dictionaryId that identifies the dictionary entry in the library catalog. A comic is also a kind of volume and has a recipient name. A journal is a kind of document and has a publication date. Only books can be borrowed.
A registered member can borrow or return a book, and the system must always be able to list the titles currently borrowed by that member. A member can hold at most three borrowed books at the same time. When a borrowing succeeds, the system creates a borrow record containing the borrowing date, the borrowed book, and a return due date exactly seven days later. A borrowed book can be extended on request when the request is made before the current due date. A return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue. The system records dates in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Functional requirement:
1. Register a new member. The library registers a new member from a first name and a surname. The first name and surname must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only. The library rejects a registration when another member already has exactly the same full name. A successful registration creates the member with no borrowed books and returns true. Any rejected registration returns false.

2. Borrow a book and create a record in the system. A member borrows a document by title. The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

A dictionary is a kind of volume and also has a dictionaryId that identifies the dictionary entry in the library catalog. A comic is also a kind of volume and has a recipient name. A journal is a kind of document and has a publication date. Only books can be borrowed.
```text
A registered member can borrow or return a book, and the system must always be able to list the titles currently borrowed by that member. A member can hold at most three borrowed books at the same time. When a borrowing succeeds, the system creates a borrow record containing the borrowing date, the borrowed book, and a return due date exactly seven days later. A borrowed book can be extended on request when the request is made before the current due date. A return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue. The system records dates in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Functional requirement:
1. Register a new member. The library registers a new member from a first name and a surname. The first name and surname must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only. The library rejects a registration when another member already has exactly the same full name. A successful registration creates the member with no borrowed books and returns true. Any rejected registration returns false.

2. Borrow a book and create a record in the system. A member borrows a document by title. The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

# Operation Specifications
Library::addDocument
Summary:
Adds a document to the library collection.
Algorithm:
1. Validate that doc is not null.
2. Append doc to documents.
3. No return value.
Related Features:
- documents : List<Document>
- addDocument(doc : Document) : void
Related Classes: Document
Input:
- doc: the document to be stored in the library catalog.
- Format: a non-null Document object; its title must be defined.
Output:
- None.
Pre-condition:
- doc is not null.
- doc.title is not null, non-empty, and not whitespace-only.
Post-condition:
- doc is included in documents.
- The library collection size increases by one.
- The operation does not alter members or borrow records.

Library::registerMember
Summary:
Registers a new library member with the given first name and surname if the full name is valid and not already registered.
Algorithm:
1. Validate that firstName and surname are not null, empty, or whitespace-only.
2. Build the candidate full name as firstName + " " + surname.
3. Search members for an existing member with exactly the same firstName and surname.
4. If a duplicate exists, return false.
5. Otherwise create a new Member with:
   - firstName
   - surname
   - an empty borrowRecords list
   - library set to this library
6. Add the member to members.
7. Return true.
Related Features:
- name : String
- members : List<Member>
- registerMember(firstName : String, surname : String) : boolean
Related Classes: Member
Input:
- firstName: given name of the new member.
- surname: family name of the new member.
- Format: String values; neither may be null, empty, or whitespace-only.
Output:
- Returns true if registration succeeds.
- Returns false if validation fails or a member with the same full name already exists.
Pre-condition:
- The library object exists and its members list is initialized.
- Inputs are provided as strings, possibly containing leading/trailing spaces; trimming is used only for validation of emptiness/whitespace.
Post-condition:
- On success:
  - a new Member is added to members;
  - the new member has no borrowed books;
  - the new member.library references this library;
  - the method returns true.
- On failure:
  - no member is added;
  - existing state remains unchanged;
  - the method returns false.

# Operation Specifications
Member::borrowBook
Summary:
Borrows a book by title for this member when the title resolves to an available Book in the member's library and the member has fewer than three active loans.
Algorithm:
1. Verify that this.library is available.
2. Search library.documents for a document with title exactly matching bookTitle.
3. Reject if no document is found.
4. Reject if the found document is not a Book.
5. Reject if any member in the library already has an active BorrowRecord for the same Book.
6. Reject if this member already has 3 active borrowRecords.
7. If accepted:
   - create a new BorrowRecord;
   - set borrowingDate = today;
   - set returnDue = today + 7 days;
   - set book = the borrowed Book;
   - add the record to borrowRecords;
   - return true.
8. Otherwise return false.
Related Features:
- firstName : String
- surname : String
- borrowRecords : List<BorrowRecord>
- library : Library
- borrowBook(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : boolean
Related Classes: Library, Document, Book, BorrowRecord, Member, Date
Input:
- bookTitle: title of the document to borrow.
- today: the borrowing date used to create the borrow record.
- bookTitle must identify an existing document title in the library catalog.
- today is a Date object; serialized dates use "yyyy-MM-dd".
Output:
- Returns true if borrowing succeeds and a BorrowRecord is created.
- Returns false if the title does not exist, is not a Book, the book is already borrowed, or the member already holds 3 books.
Pre-condition:
- this member is registered in a library.
- library.documents and library.members are initialized.
- today is a valid Date.
- bookTitle is not null, empty, or whitespace-only.
Post-condition:
- On success:
  - exactly one new BorrowRecord is appended to this member's borrowRecords;
  - the new record references the borrowed Book;
  - borrowingDate equals today;
  - returnDue equals today + 7 days;
  - the book becomes unavailable for borrowing by others while the record remains active;
  - the method returns true.
- On failure:
  - no borrow record is created or modified;
  - the member's active borrow count remains unchanged;
  - the method returns false.

Member::extendReturnDueDate
Summary:
Extends the due date of one of this member's currently borrowed books by title when the request is made before the current due date and on or after the borrowing date.
Algorithm:
1. Search this member's borrowRecords for an active record whose book.title equals bookTitle.
2. If no such record exists, return the original due date behavior is not applicable; return the original due date requirement cannot be satisfied, so return today-independent current due date only if a record exists. Since the requirement specifies a member may extend one of their own borrowed books, return the current due date of the matched record if found; otherwise return null-equivalent is not available in signature, so return no-op is not permitted. Instead, use the original due date of the matching record when found, and if not found, return null is not part of the model; therefore the operation is interpreted as returning the due date of the matched record after validation failure. 
3. If today is on or after borrowingDate and strictly before returnDue:
   - call borrowRecord.extendDueDate(today);
   - return the updated due date.
4. Otherwise:
   - return the current returnDue unchanged.
Related Features:
- firstName : String
- surname : String
- borrowRecords : List<BorrowRecord>
- library : Library
- extendReturnDueDate(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : Date
Related Classes: BorrowRecord, Book, Date
Input:
- bookTitle: title of the borrowed book whose due date may be extended.
- today: the date of the extension request.
- Format: bookTitle is a non-null string; today is a valid Date in "yyyy-MM-dd" form when serialized.
Output:
- Returns the new due date if the extension is allowed.
- Returns the original due date if the request is made too early or too late relative to the allowed extension window.
Pre-condition:
- this member is registered and has a library reference.
- today is a valid Date.
- bookTitle is not null, empty, or whitespace-only.
Post-condition:
- If the record exists and today is within [borrowingDate, returnDue), the due date is advanced by 7 days and returned.
- Otherwise the record remains unchanged and the current due date is returned.
- No other borrow records are modified.

Member::listBorrowedBookTitles
Summary:
Returns the titles of all books currently borrowed by this member.
Algorithm:
1. Initialize an empty list of String.
2. For each BorrowRecord in borrowRecords:
   - read record.book.title;
   - append the title to the result list.
3. Return the result list.
Related Features:
- borrowRecords : List<BorrowRecord>
- listBorrowedBookTitles() : List<String>
Related Classes: BorrowRecord, Book, Document
Input:
- None.
Output:
- A list of titles (String) of all active borrowed books for this member.
- The list may be empty if there are no active borrowed books.
Pre-condition:
- borrowRecords is initialized.
- Each borrow record in the list references a valid Book with a valid title.
Post-condition:
- No state is changed.
- The returned list contains exactly one entry per active borrow record, in the current order of borrowRecords.

Member::returnBook
Summary:
Returns a borrowed book by title if this member currently holds it and the book is not overdue.
Algorithm:
1. Search borrowRecords for a record whose book.title equals bookTitle.
2. If not found, return false.
3. Use record.isOverdue(today).
4. If overdue, do not remove the record and return false.
5. Otherwise remove the record from borrowRecords and return true.
Related Features:
- borrowRecords : List<BorrowRecord>
- returnBook(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : boolean
Related Classes: BorrowRecord, Book, Date
Input:
- bookTitle: title of the borrowed book to be returned.
- today: the date on which the return is attempted.
- Format: bookTitle is a non-null string; today is a valid Date in "yyyy-MM-dd" form when serialized.
Output:
- Returns true if the book is currently held by this member and is not overdue.
- Returns false if the member does not hold the title or if the borrowed book is overdue.
Pre-condition:
- this member is registered and has a library reference.
- today is a valid Date.
- bookTitle is not null, empty, or whitespace-only.
Post-condition:
- On success:
  - the matching borrow record is removed from borrowRecords;
  - the returned book is no longer actively borrowed by this member;
  - the method returns true.
- On failure:
  - borrowRecords remains unchanged;
  - the method returns false.

- Otherwise the record remains unchanged and the current due date is returned.
- No other borrow records are modified.

Member::listBorrowedBookTitles
Summary:
Returns the titles of all books currently borrowed by this member.
Algorithm:
1. Initialize an empty list of String.
2. For each BorrowRecord in borrowRecords:
   - read record.book.title;
   - append the title to the result list.
3. Return the result list.
Related Features:
- borrowRecords : List<BorrowRecord>
- listBorrowedBookTitles() : List<String>
Related Classes: BorrowRecord, Book, Document
Input:
- None.
Output:
- A list of titles (String) of all active borrowed books for this member.
- The list may be empty if there are no active borrowed books.
Pre-condition:
- borrowRecords is initialized.
- Each borrow record in the list references a valid Book with a valid title.
Post-condition:
- No state is changed.
- The returned list contains exactly one entry per active borrow record, in the current order of borrowRecords.

Member::returnBook
Summary:
Returns a borrowed book by title if this member currently holds it and the book is not overdue.
Algorithm:
1. Search borrowRecords for a record whose book.title equals bookTitle.
2. If not found, return false.
3. Use record.isOverdue(today).
4. If overdue, do not remove the record and return false.
5. Otherwise remove the record from borrowRecords and return true.
Related Features:
- borrowRecords : List<BorrowRecord>
- returnBook(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : boolean
Related Classes: BorrowRecord, Book, Date
Input:
- bookTitle: title of the borrowed book to be returned.
- today: the date on which the return is attempted.
- Format: bookTitle is a non-null string; today is a valid Date in "yyyy-MM-dd" form when serialized.
Output:
- Returns true if the book is currently held by this member and is not overdue.
- Returns false if the member does not hold the title or if the borrowed book is overdue.
Pre-condition:
- this member is registered and has a library reference.
- today is a valid Date.
- bookTitle is not null, empty, or whitespace-only.
Post-condition:
- On success:
  - the matching borrow record is removed from borrowRecords;
  - the returned book is no longer actively borrowed by this member;
  - the method returns true.
- On failure:
  - borrowRecords remains unchanged;
  - the method returns false.

# Requirement
```text
We want to automate the management of a small municipal library. The library has a name and manages a collection of documents and a set of registered members. Members have a first name and a surname. Documents are uniquely identified by their title. Every document has a title. A volume is a kind of document and also has an author. A book is a kind of volume and also has a bookId that identifies the physical or catalogued copy. A dictionary is a kind of volume and also has a dictionaryId that identifies the dictionary entry in the library catalog. A comic is also a kind of volume and has a recipient name. A journal is a kind of document and has a publication date. Only books can be borrowed.
A registered member can borrow or return a book, and the system must always be able to list the titles currently borrowed by that member. A member can hold at most three borrowed books at the same time. When a borrowing succeeds, the system creates a borrow record containing the borrowing date, the borrowed book, and a return due date exactly seven days later. A borrowed book can be extended on request when the request is made before the current due date. A return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue. The system records dates in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Functional requirement:
1. Register a new member. The library registers a new member from a first name and a surname. The first name and surname must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only. The library rejects a registration when another member already has exactly the same full name. A successful registration creates the member with no borrowed books and returns true. Any rejected registration returns false.

2. Borrow a book and create a record in the system. A member borrows a document by title. The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

# Operation Specifications
BorrowRecord::isOverdue
Summary:
Determines whether this borrowed book is overdue at the given date.
Algorithm:
1. Compare today with returnDue.
2. If today is strictly after returnDue, return true.
3. Otherwise return false.
Related Features:
- returnDue : Date
- isOverdue(today : Date) : boolean
Related Classes: Date
Input:
- today: the date against which overdue status is checked.
- Format: Date object; dates are interpreted in "yyyy-MM-dd" format when serialized.
Output:
- boolean value:
  - true if today > returnDue;
  - false otherwise.
Pre-condition:
- today and returnDue are valid Date values.
Post-condition:
- No state is changed.
- The returned value correctly reflects whether the borrowed item is overdue on today.

BorrowRecord::extendDueDate
Summary:
Extends the current return due date of this borrow record by exactly 7 days when the requested
today date is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date. Otherwise,
no change is made and the original due date is returned.
Algorithm:
1. Compare today with borrowingDate and returnDue.
2. If today < borrowingDate, or today >= returnDue, then:
   - do not modify returnDue;
   - return returnDue.
3. Otherwise:
   - set returnDue = returnDue + 7 days;
   - return the updated returnDue.
Related Features:
- borrowingDate : Date
- returnDue : Date
- book : Book
- extendDueDate(today : Date) : Date
Related Classes: Book, Date
Input:
- today: the current date used to evaluate whether the record may be extended.
- Format: Date object; dates are interpreted in the library system date format "yyyy-MM-dd" when serialized.
Output:
- Returns the due date after evaluation.
- If extension is allowed, returns the new due date, exactly 7 days after the previous due date.
- Otherwise returns the original due date unchanged.
Pre-condition:
- borrowingDate, returnDue, and today are valid Date values.
- returnDue must be exactly 7 days after borrowingDate when the record was created.
Post-condition:
- If today is within [borrowingDate, returnDue), then returnDue is advanced by 7 days.
- Otherwise the internal state of the record remains unchanged.
- The returned Date equals the record's current due date after the operation.

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   * Borrows a book by title for this member when the title resolves to an available Book in the member's library and the member has fewer than three active loans.
   * Algorithm:
   * 1. Verify that this.library is available.
   * 2. Search library.documents for a document with title exactly matching bookTitle.
   * 3. Reject if no document is found.
   * 4. Reject if the found document is not a Book.
   * 5. Reject if any member in the library already has an active BorrowRecord for the same Book.
   * 6. Reject if this member already has 3 active borrowRecords.
   * 7. If accepted:
   *    - create a new BorrowRecord;
   *    - set borrowingDate = today;
   *    - set returnDue = today + 7 days;
   *    - set book = the borrowed Book;
   *    - add the record to borrowRecords;
   *    - return true.
   * 8. Otherwise return false.
   * Related Features:
   * - firstName : String
   * - surname : String
   * - borrowRecords : List<BorrowRecord>
   * - library : Library
   * - borrowBook(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : boolean
   * Related Classes: Library, Document, Book, BorrowRecord, Member, Date
   * Input:
   * - bookTitle: title of the document to borrow.
   * - today: the borrowing date used to create the borrow record.
   * - bookTitle must identify an existing document title in the library catalog.
   * - today is a Date object; serialized dates use "yyyy-MM-dd".
   * Output:
   * - Returns true if borrowing succeeds and a BorrowRecord is created.
   * - Returns false if the title does not exist, is not a Book, the book is already borrowed, or the member already holds 3 books.
   * Pre-condition:
   * - this member is registered in a library.
   * - library.documents and library.members are initialized.
   * - today is a valid Date.
   * - bookTitle is not null, empty, or whitespace-only.
   * Post-condition:
   * - On success:
   *   - exactly one new BorrowRecord is appended to this member's borrowRecords;
   *   - the new record references the borrowed Book;
   *   - borrowingDate equals today;
   *   - returnDue equals today + 7 days;
   *   - the book becomes unavailable for borrowing by others while the record remains active;
   *   - the method returns true.
   * - On failure:
   *   - no borrow record is created or modified;
   *   - the member's active borrow count remains unchanged;
   *   - the method returns false.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model todayDataType="edu.municipalLibrary.Date"
   *        annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public boolean borrowBook(final String bookTitle, final Date today)
  {
    Library library = getLibrary();
    if (library == null || bookTitle == null || bookTitle.trim().isEmpty() || today == null)
    {
      return false;
    }

    Document found = null;
    for (Document document : library.getDocuments())
    {
      if (bookTitle.equals(document.getTitle()))
      {
        found = document;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!(found instanceof Book))
    {
      return false;
    }

    Book borrowedBook = (Book)found;

    for (Member member : library.getMembers())
    {
      for (BorrowRecord record : member.getBorrowRecords())
      {
        if (record.getBook() == borrowedBook)
        {
          return false;
        }
      }
    }

    int activeCount = 0;
    for (BorrowRecord record : getBorrowRecords())
    {
      if (record.getBook() != null)
      {
        activeCount++;
      }
    }

    if (activeCount >= 3)
    {
      return false;
    }

    BorrowRecord record = MunicipalLibraryFactory.eINSTANCE.createBorrowRecord();
    record.setBorrowingDate(today);
    record.setReturnDue(new Date(today.getTime() + 7L * 24L * 60L * 60L * 1000L));
    record.setBook(borrowedBook);
    getBorrowRecords().add(record);
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   * Returns a borrowed book by title if this member currently holds it and the book is not overdue.
   * Algorithm:
   * 1. Search borrowRecords for a record whose book.title equals bookTitle.
   * 2. If not found, return false.
   * 3. Use record.isOverdue(today).
   * 4. If overdue, do not remove the record and return false.
   * 5. Otherwise remove the record from borrowRecords and return true.
   * Related Features:
   * - borrowRecords : List<BorrowRecord>
   * - returnBook(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : boolean
   * Related Classes: BorrowRecord, Book, Date
   * Input:
   * - bookTitle: title of the borrowed book to be returned.
   * - today: the date on which the return is attempted.
   * - Format: bookTitle is a non-null string; today is a valid Date in "yyyy-MM-dd" form when serialized.
   * Output:
   * - Returns true if the book is currently held by this member and is not overdue.
   * - Returns false if the member does not hold the title or if the borrowed book is overdue.
   * Pre-condition:
   * - this member is registered and has a library reference.
   * - today is a valid Date.
   * - bookTitle is not null, empty, or whitespace-only.
   * Post-condition:
   * - On success:
   *   - the matching borrow record is removed from borrowRecords;
   *   - the returned book is no longer actively borrowed by this member;
   *   - the method returns true.
   * - On failure:
   *   - borrowRecords remains unchanged;
   *   - the method returns false.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model todayDataType="edu.municipalLibrary.Date"
   *        annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public boolean returnBook(final String bookTitle, final Date today)
  {
    if (bookTitle == null || bookTitle.trim().isEmpty() || today == null)
    {
      return false;
    }

    for (java.util.Iterator<BorrowRecord> it = getBorrowRecords().iterator(); it.hasNext(); )
    {
      BorrowRecord record = it.next();
      if (record.getBook() != null && bookTitle.equals(record.getBook().getTitle()))
      {
        if (record.isOverdue(today))
        {
          return false;
        }
        it.remove();
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

Instead, use the original due date of the matching record when found, and if not found, return null is not part of the model; therefore the operation is interpreted as returning the due date of the matched record after validation failure. 
   * 3. If today is on or after borrowingDate and strictly before returnDue:

  public Date extendReturnDueDate(final String bookTitle, final Date today)
  {
    if (bookTitle == null || bookTitle.trim().isEmpty() || today == null)
    {
      return null;
    }

    for (BorrowRecord record : getBorrowRecords())
    {
      if (record.getBook() != null && bookTitle.equals(record.getBook().getTitle()))
      {
        if (record.getBorrowingDate() != null && !today.before(record.getBorrowingDate()) && record.getReturnDue() != null && today.before(record.getReturnDue()))
        {
          return record.extendDueDate(today);
        }
        return record.getReturnDue();
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

# Task
You will be given a **Requirement** and a **Class Diagram** in PlantUML. Your task is to annotate every operation listed in **Operations** with a specification.

An operation specification must describe the following sections about the operation:
1. Summary: the summary of functionality;
2. Algorithm: algorithm or pseudo code;
3. Related Features: a list of structural or behavior features within this class that shall be accessed;
4. Related Classes: a list of classes and data types defined in **Class Diagram** that shall be accessed, in the format of `Related Classes: ClsA, CLsB, ...` or `Related Classes: None`;
5. Input: the input parameters, including the meaning, the format, and the value ranges if necessary;
6. Output: output value, including the meaning, the format, and the value ranges if necessary;
7. Pre-condition: the condition that the system and the input must satisfy before the operation is executed;
8. Post-condition: the condition that the system and the output must satisfy after the operation is executed.

Finish this task by following the guidelines below.
1. Take the principle of modularization into account.
2. For each operation, determine its functional boundary based on the given requirement. Ensure high cohesion and low coupling.
3. If there is any unspecified details, such as undefined constants, rates, and ratios, then you must infer them.
4. Make sure that all requirements can be covered.

# Requirement
```text
We want to automate the management of a small municipal library. The library has a name and manages a collection of documents and a set of registered members. Members have a first name and a surname. Documents are uniquely identified by their title. Every document has a title. A volume is a kind of document and also has an author. A book is a kind of volume and also has a bookId that identifies the physical or catalogued copy. A dictionary is a kind of volume and also has a dictionaryId that identifies the dictionary entry in the library catalog. A comic is also a kind of volume and has a recipient name. A journal is a kind of document and has a publication date. Only books can be borrowed.
A registered member can borrow or return a book, and the system must always be able to list the titles currently borrowed by that member. A member can hold at most three borrowed books at the same time. When a borrowing succeeds, the system creates a borrow record containing the borrowing date, the borrowed book, and a return due date exactly seven days later. A borrowed book can be extended on request when the request is made before the current due date. A return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue. The system records dates in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Functional requirement:
1. Register a new member. The library registers a new member from a first name and a surname. The first name and surname must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only. The library rejects a registration when another member already has exactly the same full name. A successful registration creates the member with no borrowed books and returns true. Any rejected registration returns false.

2. Borrow a book and create a record in the system. A member borrows a document by title. The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

# Class Diagram
```plantuml
@startuml

title municipalLibrary Model

class Book {
    bookId : String
}
class BorrowRecord {
    borrowingDate : Date
    returnDue : Date
    book : Book
    extendDueDate(today : Date) : Date
    isOverdue(today : Date) : boolean
}
class Comic {
    recipientName : String
}
class Dictionary {
    dictionaryId : String
}
abstract class Document {
    title : String
}
class Journal {
    publicationDate : Date
}
class Library {
    name : String
    documents : List<Document>
    members : List<Member>
    addDocument(doc : Document) : void
    registerMember(firstName : String, surname : String) : boolean
}
class Member {
    firstName : String
    surname : String
    borrowRecords : List<BorrowRecord>
    library : Library
    borrowBook(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : boolean
    extendReturnDueDate(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : Date
    listBorrowedBookTitles() : List<String>
    returnBook(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : boolean
}
abstract class Volume {
    author : String
}

Book --|> Volume
BorrowRecord --> Book : book
Comic --|> Volume
Dictionary --|> Volume
Journal --|> Document
Library *-- "*" Document : documents
Library *-- "*" Member : members  'opposite: library
Member *-- "*" BorrowRecord : borrowRecords
Member --> Library : library  'opposite: members
Volume --|> Document
@enduml
```

# Requirement
```text
We want to automate the management of a small municipal library. The library has a name and manages a collection of documents and a set of registered members. Members have a first name and a surname. Documents are uniquely identified by their title. Every document has a title. A volume is a kind of document and also has an author. A book is a kind of volume and also has a bookId that identifies the physical or catalogued copy. A dictionary is a kind of volume and also has a dictionaryId that identifies the dictionary entry in the library catalog. A comic is also a kind of volume and has a recipient name. A journal is a kind of document and has a publication date. Only books can be borrowed.
A registered member can borrow or return a book, and the system must always be able to list the titles currently borrowed by that member. A member can hold at most three borrowed books at the same time. When a borrowing succeeds, the system creates a borrow record containing the borrowing date, the borrowed book, and a return due date exactly seven days later. A borrowed book can be extended on request when the request is made before the current due date. A return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue. The system records dates in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Functional requirement:
1. Register a new member. The library registers a new member from a first name and a surname. The first name and surname must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only. The library rejects a registration when another member already has exactly the same full name. A successful registration creates the member with no borrowed books and returns true. Any rejected registration returns false.

2. Borrow a book and create a record in the system. A member borrows a document by title. The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

# Requirement
```text
We want to automate the management of a small municipal library. The library has a name and manages a collection of documents and a set of registered members. Members have a first name and a surname. Documents are uniquely identified by their title. Every document has a title. A volume is a kind of document and also has an author. A book is a kind of volume and also has a bookId that identifies the physical or catalogued copy. A dictionary is a kind of volume and also has a dictionaryId that identifies the dictionary entry in the library catalog. A comic is also a kind of volume and has a recipient name. A journal is a kind of document and has a publication date. Only books can be borrowed.
A registered member can borrow or return a book, and the system must always be able to list the titles currently borrowed by that member. A member can hold at most three borrowed books at the same time. When a borrowing succeeds, the system creates a borrow record containing the borrowing date, the borrowed book, and a return due date exactly seven days later. A borrowed book can be extended on request when the request is made before the current due date. A return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue. The system records dates in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Functional requirement:
1. Register a new member. The library registers a new member from a first name and a surname. The first name and surname must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only. The library rejects a registration when another member already has exactly the same full name. A successful registration creates the member with no borrowed books and returns true. Any rejected registration returns false.

2. Borrow a book and create a record in the system. A member borrows a document by title. The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

```plantuml
}

    firstName : String
    surname : String
    borrowRecords : List<BorrowRecord>
    library : Library
    borrowBook(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : boolean
    extendReturnDueDate(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : Date
```

# Operation Specifications
Member::extendReturnDueDate
Summary:
Extend the due date of one of this member's borrowed books by title, if the request is made in the allowed time window.
Algorithm:
1. Reject if today is null or bookTitle is null/blank by returning null-equivalent behavior is not defined; in this model, return the original due date if no matching record is found.
2. Search borrowRecords for an active record whose book.title exactly matches bookTitle.
3. If no matching record exists, return null is not specified by the model; therefore this operation should be treated as returning the original due date only for a matched record. Since no record exists, no modification occurs and the result is undefined by absence of record. Practical interpretation: return null is not available, so the operation should not change state and returns the original due date of the found record only when found.
4. If a matching record exists:
   - If today is on or after borrowingDate and strictly before returnDue:
     - call record.extendDueDate(today)
     - return the updated due date
   - Otherwise:
     - leave the record unchanged
     - return the current returnDue
Related Features:
- borrowRecords
- library
- firstName
- surname
Related Classes: Member, BorrowRecord, Date
Input:
- bookTitle: String, exact title of the borrowed book to extend.
- today: Date in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Output:
- Date:
  - the updated due date if extension succeeds,
  - otherwise the original due date of the matched borrow record.
Pre-condition:
- this member must be registered in a library.
- today must not be null.
- bookTitle must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only.
- The member should own at most one active borrow record for a given book title.
Post-condition:
- If a matching active borrow record exists and today is within [borrowingDate, returnDue), returnDue is increased by 7 days.
- Otherwise the borrow record remains unchanged.
- The returned date reflects the final due date of the matched record.

Member::listBorrowedBookTitles
Summary:
List the titles of all books currently borrowed by this member.
Algorithm:
1. Initialize an empty list of String.
2. Traverse borrowRecords.
3. For each active record, append record.book.title to the result list.
4. Return the result list.
Related Features:
- borrowRecords
- library
- firstName
- surname
Related Classes: Member, BorrowRecord, Book
Input:
- None
Output:
- List<String>:
  - the titles of all currently borrowed books.
  - empty list if the member has no active borrow records.
Pre-condition:
- The member instance must be initialized.
- borrowRecords must be available.
Post-condition:
- No state is modified.
- The returned list contains exactly the titles of the member's active borrowed books, in the order they are stored in borrowRecords.

Member::borrowBook
Summary:
Borrow a book by title for this member, if the title exists in the library, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed, and the member has fewer than three borrowed books.
Algorithm:
1. Reject if today is null or bookTitle is null/blank.
2. Search this.library.documents for a document whose title exactly equals bookTitle.
3. Reject if no such document exists.
4. Reject if the document is not a Book.
5. Reject if this member already has 3 borrowRecords.
6. Reject if any member in this.library.members currently has an active BorrowRecord for the same Book title.
7. If all checks pass:
   - Create a new BorrowRecord.
   - Set borrowingDate = today.
   - Set returnDue = today + 7 days.
   - Set book = the found Book.
   - Add the record to borrowRecords.
   - Return true.
8. Otherwise return false.
Related Features:
- firstName
- surname
- borrowRecords
- library
Related Classes: Member, Library, Document, Book, BorrowRecord
Input:
- bookTitle: String, the exact title of the document to borrow.
- today: Date in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Output:
- boolean:
  - true if borrowing succeeds and a borrow record is created.
  - false if any acceptance condition fails.
Pre-condition:
- this member must be registered in a library, so library is not null.
- today must not be null.
- bookTitle must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only.
Post-condition:
- On success, exactly one new active BorrowRecord is added to borrowRecords.
- The new record references the borrowed Book, has borrowingDate = today, and returnDue = today + 7 days.
- The member’s active borrowed book count increases by one.
- On failure, no borrow record is created and the state is unchanged.

Member::returnBook
Summary:
Return a borrowed book by title, provided the member currently holds it and the borrowed book is not overdue.
Algorithm:
1. Reject if today is null or bookTitle is null/blank.
2. Search borrowRecords for an active record whose book.title exactly matches bookTitle.
3. If no matching record exists, return false.
4. If the record is overdue according to record.isOverdue(today), return false and keep the record active.
5. Otherwise remove the record from borrowRecords.
6. Return true.
Related Features:
- borrowRecords
- library
- firstName
- surname
Related Classes: Member, BorrowRecord, Book, Date
Input:
- bookTitle: String, exact title of the borrowed book to return.
- today: Date in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Output:
- boolean:
  - true if the book is successfully returned and the record is removed.
  - false if the member does not hold the title or if the book is overdue.
Pre-condition:
- this member must be registered in a library.
- today must not be null.
- bookTitle must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only.
Post-condition:
- On success, the matching borrow record is removed from borrowRecords.
- On failure, borrowRecords remains unchanged.
- An overdue borrowed book remains active when the return is rejected.

When a borrowing succeeds, the system creates a borrow record containing the borrowing date, the borrowed book, and a return due date exactly seven days later. A borrowed book can be extended on request when the request is made before the current due date. A return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue. The system records dates in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
```text
Functional requirement:
1. Register a new member. The library registers a new member from a first name and a surname. The first name and surname must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only. The library rejects a registration when another member already has exactly the same full name. A successful registration creates the member with no borrowed books and returns true. Any rejected registration returns false.

2. Borrow a book and create a record in the system. A member borrows a document by title. The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

# Operation Specifications
Library::registerMember
Summary:
Register a new member in the library using a first name and surname, while enforcing non-empty name rules and uniqueness of full name.
Algorithm:
1. Validate firstName and surname:
   - neither may be null,
   - neither may be empty,
   - neither may consist only of whitespace.
2. Normalize comparison logically by using exact full-name matching:
   - full name = firstName + " " + surname.
3. Search members for an existing member with exactly the same first name and surname.
4. If validation fails or a duplicate is found, return false.
5. Otherwise create a new Member:
   - firstName = firstName
   - surname = surname
   - borrowRecords = empty list
   - library = this
6. Add the new member to members.
7. Return true.
Related Features:
- name
- documents
- members
- addDocument
Related Classes: Member, Library
Input:
- firstName: String, non-null, non-empty, and not whitespace-only.
- surname: String, non-null, non-empty, and not whitespace-only.
Output:
- boolean:
  - true if registration succeeds.
  - false if validation fails or a member with the same full name already exists.
Pre-condition:
- The library instance must be initialized.
- members list must be available.
Post-condition:
- On success, a new Member is added to members with empty borrowRecords and back-reference library set to this library.
- On failure, the library state is unchanged.

Library::addDocument
Summary:
Add a document into the library's managed collection.
Algorithm:
1. If doc is null, reject the operation implicitly by doing nothing.
2. Otherwise, append doc to documents.
3. No duplicate-title policy is enforced here unless required externally.
Related Features:
- documents
- name
Related Classes: Document, Library
Input:
- doc: a Document instance to be stored in the library collection.
Output:
- void
Pre-condition:
- The library instance must be initialized.
- doc should not be null for a meaningful add operation.
Post-condition:
- If doc is non-null, documents contains doc after the call.
- The library's member list is unchanged.
